summary: Defensive verification of admin login bug fix. Ran 9 backend pytest cases + Playwright end-to-end UI flow. All scenarios pass: correct creds succeed and land on /admin/dashboard, email normalization works (mixed case + trailing space), wrong password shows the Bahasa Indonesia error 'Email atau password salah. Coba lagi.', submit button correctly disabled when email OR password empty, token persists across `supervisorctl restart backend` (Mongo admin_sessions), corrupted localStorage token triggers 401 interceptor which clears token + redirects to /admin/login, and admin_users seed contains a bcrypt $2b$ hash with no raw password field.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLoginPage line 17: reading localStorage during render + returning <Navigate> is fine but there is no server-side token validity check on mount — if token exists but is expired, user will land on /admin/dashboard and only get bounced back by the 401 interceptor after first API call. Minor UX nit.

Backend admin_routes.py LoginRequest: `password: str` is required but empty string passes Pydantic validation; the bcrypt check then fails with 401 which is acceptable but a 400 for empty password would be cleaner.
admin_sessions has no TTL index in Mongo — expired sessions accumulate. Consider `db.admin_sessions.create_index('expires_at', expireAfterSeconds=0)` at startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login is fully working. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_login.py — reuse them for regression. UI selectors verified: [data-testid='admin-email-input'], [data-testid='admin-password-input'], [data-testid='admin-login-submit'], [data-testid='admin-tab-home'] on dashboard. Token key in localStorage: 'huniaja_admin_token'.
rca of the issue: Original user complaint 'tidak bisa masuk ke dashboard admin' was resolved by the earlier fix (bcrypt-based DB-backed admin_users + Mongo-backed admin_sessions with 7-day TTL + idempotent seed_admin on startup + improved frontend error mapping). Current iteration confirms no regressions.
